title: F169.2 the docs page's type and edges: the overview
caption: Four picks become headings sized by rank, four named corners, a step's number each theme draws its own way, and edges that line up.

cards.title: F169.2 The docs page's type and edges
cards.text: A docs page shows three heading sizes and no other, its corners have names, and every block of words ends on the page's edge.

cards.title: Headings by rank
cards.text: A band can be a part of a section, and its title is then an h3. The docs layout sizes the three ranks: 74, 40, 28, and 40, 32, 24 on a phone. Steps 2, 3 and 4.

cards.title: Four corner names
cards.text: Every theme sets them. The docs page's parts read them, and Orbi's panel takes the window's corner. Steps 5 and 6.

cards.title: A step's number
cards.text: The theme decides. Flat sets a squared label, glass and retro keep the circle they show today. Steps 7 and 8.

cards.title: The edges
cards.text: The rows read as the steps do, the page turn lines up with the words above it, and the menu's line runs the page's height. Step 9.
